cases.prompt: Before approving this authentication pull request, inspect the supplied diff for authorization bypasses and report findings with file and line evidence.
Examine the attached concurrency branch for lost updates or race conditions and tell me whether the change is safe to merge.
Review the UI patch for keyboard and screen-reader regressions introduced by these changes, with each finding tied to the code.
Audit this database migration pull request for data-loss paths, unsafe rollback behavior, and missing transactional protection before merge.
Check the supplied API change set for backward-compatibility defects and identify any merge blockers with exact code locations.
Inspect this payment retry diff and find behavior changes that are not protected by the added tests before I approve the pull request.
Create customer-facing release notes for the changes already merged since version 2.4 and clearly flag any missing verification evidence.
Turn yesterday's outage timeline, customer impact, remediation notes, and follow-up owners into a concise operational incident summary.
Apply the reviewer comments to this branch, update the authorization code, and add the regression tests needed to make the pull request pass.
The checkout test fails intermittently in CI. Reproduce the failure, identify its cause, and implement a reliable fix in the application.
Write a clear pull-request title and description that summarize the completed caching changes, test coverage, rollout plan, and screenshots.
Explain how our team can run more useful code reviews and suggest a practical checklist for authors and reviewers to follow.
Tell me whether the attached branch is safe to land and point me to every behavioral problem that should block approval.
Inspect this dependency-upgrade commit for supply-chain, runtime compatibility, and lockfile risks before it is accepted.
Examine the query pagination patch for new N+1 calls, unbounded work, or correctness regressions and cite the affected lines.
Check these React changes for stale state, keyboard failures, and request races, then return only actionable findings tied to the diff.
Prepare the customer update for work shipped since last Thursday, separating visible improvements from internal engineering changes.
Review this proposed event-driven architecture document and identify unclear ownership, scaling assumptions, and unanswered design questions.
Give leadership a non-technical summary of this already approved diff, focusing on business impact rather than code-level findings.
Review the remediation patch for merge blockers and then use the outage timeline to write the final incident report in the same workflow.
